NEXT MILESTONE UNNAMED. Both v0.5 deliverables shipped (campaigns entities on 2026-08-03/04, the proficiency training tracker recorded in CHANGELOG.md), so v0.5 is closed and nothing has been declared after it. Naming what comes next is Kane’s, and the number below cannot move honestly until something does.

Basis for the 55 percent hold: the figure is NOT re-derived here. It was anchored 2026-07-06 and the two deliverables that closed since were already counted toward it when it was set. Re-anchoring the date without moving the number records that the staleness was looked at on 2026-08-24 and that the number was left deliberately, rather than leaving a date that implies nobody has checked in seven weeks (bar-raise observability-02 / strategic-kill-this-01).

barRaise.topFinding: The BLOCK is closed and it is closed on the live site, not just in the build: an anonymous fetch this morning found 802 records in preview.json and 1,134 in search-index.json with zero gated entity records and zero gated URLs, and sampled gated pages answered 401. That closes nine findings at once across five lenses. What keeps the verdict at needs-attention is a different exposure nobody has touched: the nightly key-value backup still reads only the six fields the export endpoint returns, so player character sheets, map pin corrections, hook pins, dismissal state, and pending forge rolls are backed up nowhere, and they are hand-entered and non-reconstructable. The release pipeline also still prints a completion line and posts to Discord after a run that skipped the deploy because the token file was missing. Open actions moved 49 to 47 against 9 closed, so a strong week of closure was almost exactly offset by seven new findings.
